title: Read hosted design versions
responsibility: Validate committed design metadata and expose versions or exact verified image bytes.

inputs.name: hubDesignImage.context
inputs.description: Source context used by hubRead to read committed files. hubDesigns also uses its tree entries to select this plan's versioned design metadata; the context contains source and cache adapters with methods that JSON cannot express.

inputs.name: hubDesignImage.plan
inputs.description: Parsed plan data that identifies the owning unit and repository-relative path. The path selects the design files, while unitId is checked against each parsed design.

examples.title: Read hosted design versions
examples.goal: Read and validate committed design metadata.

inputs.name: hubDesignImage.input
inputs.description: Selects the design version and image by version label and expected SHA-256 digest. The design schema accepts versions beginning with v and at least three digits, and the digest must match one of that version's images.

inputs.name: hubDesigns.context
inputs.description: Source context used by hubRead to read committed files. hubDesigns also uses its tree entries to select this plan's versioned design metadata; the context contains source and cache adapters with methods that JSON cannot express.

inputs.name: hubDesigns.plan
inputs.description: Parsed plan data that identifies the owning unit and repository-relative path. The path selects the design files, while unitId is checked against each parsed design.

examples.title: Read hosted design versions
examples.goal: Read and validate committed design metadata.

inputs.name: design.context
inputs.description: Source context used by hubRead to read committed files. hubDesigns also uses its tree entries to select this plan's versioned design metadata; the context contains source and cache adapters with methods that JSON cannot express.

inputs.name: design.plan
inputs.description: Parsed plan data that identifies the owning unit and repository-relative path. The path selects the design files, while unitId is checked against each parsed design.

examples.title: Read hosted design versions
examples.goal: Read and validate committed design metadata.

inputs.name: design.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path passed to hubRead for the design JSON. It must equal the plan path joined with designs/<version>/design.json, and the parsed unitId and contractHash are validated.

outputs.name: hubDesigns
outputs.description: Returns the committed design versions in numeric version order and requires a gapless sequence starting at v001. Each version includes the decoded prompt, optional notes, image, approval, option and revision data; commit is null, and only an approval for the newest version is marked current.

outputs.name: hubDesignImage
outputs.description: Returns the original PNG bytes for the image selected by the SHA-256 digest after content hash, stored byte length and decoded dimensions are verified. Missing design/image records fail with not-found, while mismatched image length or dimensions fail with artifact-corrupt.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with code not-found when a requested committed design or image is absent, or code artifact-corrupt when design JSON, schema, identity/path/hash, option, version-sequence, image-length or PNG-dimension validation fails.

examples.title: Read hosted design versions

inputs.name: design.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path passed to hubRead for the design JSON. It must equal the plan path joined with designs/<version>/design.json, and the parsed unitId and contractHash are validated.

outputs.name: design
outputs.description: Returns schema-validated design metadata after checking that unitId matches the plan, path matches the versioned design location and contractHash matches the contract contents. If options are present, their ids must be ordered from o1, their directions must be distinct after trimming and case-folding, and they must assign each image exactly once without sharing images across options.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with code not-found for a missing design artifact, or code artifact-corrupt for invalid JSON/schema, unitId or path mismatch, contract-hash mismatch, or invalid option assignments.
